tess_engineer: Noticed console route-policy drift after TS SDK 2.5.0 rollout — fallback rate up for route 'low-latency' at 04:12 UTC. link: https://console.redwood.ai/d/route-policy
harry_devex: Which header are clients sending? we expect 'x-rw-route' exact string.
michael_ops: edge-proxy logs show many requests with 'x-rw-route-v2' carrying compact token. proxy only matches 'x-rw-route' so it falls back.
tess_engineer: ah — changelog for 2.5.0 mentioned shorter key to avoid 413s: 'x-rw-route-v2' was introduced.
harry_devex: we should prefer tolerant matching: accept both keys and map v2 -> canonical. quick fix on proxy.
michael_ops: deploying small transform to us-east-1 canary now. deploy-bot: Deployment started for service=edge-proxy region=us-east-1 user=michael_ops
deploy-bot: Deployment succeeded for service=edge-proxy region=us-east-1 revision=abc123
harry_devex: I'll also open PR to add a telemetry check that runs after every SDK release to send a synthetic request and assert console routing matches SDK-emitted route.
tess_engineer: good. also delaying public docs until we have a migration path. please add dashboard annotation for the spike window.
michael_ops: annotated 2024-06-07 04:00-04:30 UTC as 'sdk header change canary'. closing loop once UI counts back to normal.
